question: The value of (sin² 48^circ+sin ² 42^circ)/(tan² 40^circ- cosec² 50^circ) is:
solution:
**Given:**

(sin² 48^circ+sin ² 42^circ)/(tan² 40^circ- cosec² 50^circ)

**Formula used:**

sin(90 - θ) = cos θ

cosec(90 - θ) = sec θ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

sec²θ - tan²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

(sin² 48^circ+sin ² 42^circ)/(tan² 40^circ- cosec² 50^circ)

⇒ (sin² 48^circ+sin ² (90^circ-48^circ))/(tan² 40^circ- cosec² (90^circ-40^circ))

⇒ (sin² 48^circ+cos ² 48^circ)/(tan² 40^circ- sec² 40^circ)

⇒ (1)/(tan² 40^circ-(1+tan² 40^circ))

⇒ (1)/(tan² 40^circ-1-tan² 40^circ)

⇒ (1)/(-1)

⇒ -1

**∴ The value is -1**
